history.label: Initial pilot
limitations: No detached replay or strict safety qualification; a different four-scenario panel.
history.summary: One PI-Lagrangian policy completed training. It delivered less value than the initial policy and heuristic on all four development scenarios.

history.label: Batch 001
limitations: Earlier development panel; no policy qualified.
history.summary: Five policies completed 131,072 transitions each. Every PPO arm failed the strict safety and daily resource-return conditions in all eight scenarios.

history.label: Batch 002
limitations: No demonstrated Operating MPC benefit; earlier development panel.
history.summary: Four policies completed 131,072 transitions each. Heuristic residuals produced modest gains over the heuristic, with forced stops and delivery/resource regressions.

history.label: Batch 003
limitations: Eight earlier development scenarios; M24 and E-beta stopped before completing their weeks.
history.summary: One MPC-residual scalar policy completed 32,768 transitions. Mean value improved by EUR 104.98 versus MPC; individual delivery and resource regressions prevented qualification.

history.label: Batch 004
limitations: Planned transitions are not completed training.
history.summary: Two 65,536-transition runs were attempted. A forecast-interface failure stopped training before the first PPO update; no trained endpoints or evaluation.

history.label: Batch 005
limitations: Exact final transitions and optimizer updates are unknown.
history.summary: Two training attempts were interrupted with storage loss. Three ledgers survived per arm; no final checkpoints or evaluation were admitted.

history.label: Batch 006
limitations: Subsequent partial progress is unknown; neither run is a completed policy.
history.summary: Both interrupted runs preserved 24,576 transitions and 960 updates. Host hibernation prevented completed endpoints and evaluation.

history.label: Batch 007
limitations: A separate allocated-byte metadata mismatch also prevented admission. The two exact endpoints were later admitted and evaluated in Batch 008.
history.summary: Scalar and PI policies each completed 65,536 transitions and 2,560 updates. A power-guard false positive aborted replay while on AC power; the campaign's performance was not admitted.

history.label: Batch 008
limitations: Development evidence only; 40 complete weeks and 16 stopped prefixes across seven actors.
history.summary: The two Batch 007 endpoints were admitted without new training. Both passed hard safety in eight scenarios but returned lower mean value than Operating MPC, with delivery/resource regressions.

history.label: Batch 009
limitations: Eight reused development scenarios and seven reused Batch 008 actors; neither policy qualified or was promoted.
history.summary: Two scalar policies completed 16,384 transitions each. Mean value improved by EUR 143.87 and EUR 145.48 versus Operating MPC, with individual delivery/resource regressions.

limitations: Development evidence only. No registered-study selection, held-out confirmation, commercial savings or site-generalization claim.
All four evaluated trained policies pass hard safety in eight completed weeks, but fail daily resource-return conditions and worsen individual deliveries or resources.
Recovery uses an accepted optimized MPC plan. Only Fallback uses the heuristic; zero Scheduled decisions does not mean zero optimization.
Stopped M24 and E-beta prefixes have no complete-week value or safety result. Observed prefix safety is retained separately.
Batch 009 reuses seven Batch 008 actor records. Earlier history uses different scenarios and is not pooled into matched comparisons.
Reward curves are scaled immediate training reward, not evaluation profit. Critic diagnostics are recorded before each update; no interpolation creates additional evidence.

policies.label: Scalar PPO · 65k
limitations: Experimental MPC-residual policy: 139 inputs and four residual actions; requires the causal MPC prior.
One optimizer seed and eight reused development scenarios; no held-out confirmation or operational promotion.
Recorded rollout statistics and pre-update diagnostics do not establish convergence or fixed-scenario improvement during training.
